# Metadata fixtures

These are original deterministic test fixtures created for this repository. No lecture, private data, network download, AI output or provider is involved. `synthetic.ts` generates bytes in memory; `hashes.json` records their fixed SHA-256/size. Tests verify those bytes are unchanged after parsing.

- WAV: PCM format1, mono, 8kHz, 16-bit, 8000 samples, exactly1 second. RIFF/chunk size, byteRate16000 and blockAlign2 are independent assertions.
- M4A: unfragmented one-track ISO BMFF, movie/track/media durations8000/8000, stts8 samples ×1000 ticks, mp4a description, stsz8 ×2bytes, one stco/stsc chunk pointing inside mdat. Exactly1 structural second. This deliberately tests container/sample-table facts; its placeholder AAC payload is not a decode/playability or actual iPhone-recorder compatibility fixture.
- MP3 tests: complete synthetic MPEG1 LayerIII frame envelopes (CBR128k and VBR128/160k), two frames ×1152 samples /44100Hz. Payloads do not claim successful full decode.
- PDF: genuine PDF1.7 catalog/page tree/xref/trailer with1 or10 blank rotated pages, 300×200 points. Broken references/truncation are derived from these fixtures. These do not exercise scanned page rendering, encrypted/object-stream PDF or all PDF decompression attacks.
- PPTX: store-only deterministic ZIP with real namespaces/relationships/content-types. Presentation order is slide9 then slide2; slide9 hidden. Orphan and incorrect app.xml count999 must not change the result. Derived hostile fixtures test duplicate/missing/unsafe/external/XML/bomb cases.
- PNG: a1×1 PNG. Bounds are header/structure facts, not full decode proof.
- JPEG: an original30×20 solid RGB(102,153,204) image encoded locally with @napi-rs/canvas1.0.8, with nonessential APP0/ICC removed. Real DQT/DHT/SOF/scan data remains. A deterministic EXIF segment applies orientations1–8. Displayed edge coordinates mirror/rotate explicitly. Progressive JPEG is not independently fixture-proven.
- TXT/MD: UTF-8, BOM removal, CRLF/CR→LF; Korean text preserved. Bounds count1-based normalized lines, including the trailing empty line.

Security-fix fixtures in `imageStructures.ts` include ICNS/JXL/HEIF zero-length structures with spoofed PNG/JPEG suffixes; these are only executed in the real externally terminable worker, never the test process. Format-specific PNG/JPEG parsing rejects them before any unsupported format dispatch. PNG fixtures test exact signatures/chunk envelopes, IHDR fields, ordering and finite iterations; PNG eXIf/APNG is rejected. PNG CRC and pixel decompression are not asserted by this structural metadata boundary. JPEG fixtures exercise SOI/SOF0/SOF2/SOS/entropy-marker boundaries/EOI plus checked classic TIFF EXIF in both endian orders, with orientation1–8 in the primary IFD. Duplicate EXIF blocks/tags, nonprimary orientation and malformed offsets/types/counts reject. Unknown non-Exif APP1 content is not interpreted.

The new progressive JPEG is an original30×20 RGB(102,153,204) image encoded and independently decoded in memory with bundled Pillow12.3.0, JPEG quality85/progressive=True. It is526bytes, SHA256 `d88527174d495e30a83627281b0cf4d3230f425c3a49b69e8c08d889e32480f7`. This supplements the baseline raster, rather than relabeling baseline SOF bytes as progressive. JPEG metadata checks do not claim to decode/validate every entropy coefficient, Huffman/quantization table or visual pixel.

`pdfTree.ts` adds genuine deterministic nested object graphs and Flate-compressed object streams with type2 cross-reference-stream entries. A compressed source below10k expands to an8MiB padded object stream inside the terminable worker; valid pages succeed, inconsistent counts reject, deadline cleanup permits a subsequent image parse. It is a bounded stress/recovery sample, not a maximum-memory or arbitrary decompression safety proof. The PDF library may allocate decoded object streams before custom tree caps; V8 heap ceilings do not fully cover ArrayBuffer/native allocation.

Worker fixtures are test-only: the stuck fixture intentionally never cooperates, invalid output adds a forbidden field, and guard-probe checks denial of filesystem/network entry points. `electron-smoke-main.ts` is selected only at build time for uniquely named smoke packages. None of these source fixtures is copied into normal app archives.
